<style>
.faq-pill-badge {
  user-select: none;
}

.faq-pill-badge svg {
  fill: currentColor;
}

.faq-subtitle a {
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.faq-subtitle a:hover, .faq-subtitle a:hover .elementor-heading-title, .faq-subtitle a:hover .elementor-icon, .faq-subtitle a:hover .elementor-button {
  color: #1D4ED8 !important;
  border-bottom-color: #1D4ED8;
}

.faq-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.faq-card:hover {
  border-color: #CBD5E1 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.02) !important;
}

.faq-card.is-open {
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.02) !important;
}

.faq-trigger {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 64px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  font-family: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.faq-trigger:hover {
  background-color: #F8FAFC !important;
}

.faq-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25) !important;
}

.faq-question {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0F172A;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  flex: 1;
}

.faq-indicator {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background-color: #F8FAFC;
  border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
  color: #64748B;
  transition: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 
                  background-color 0.2s ease, 
                  border-color 0.2s ease, 
                  color 0.2s ease;
}

.faq-indicator svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  stroke-width: 2.2;
  transition: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.faq-trigger:hover .faq-indicator {
  background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  border-color: #CBD5E1 !important;
  color: #0F172A !important;
}

.faq-card.is-open .faq-indicator {
  background-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08) !important;
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2) !important;
  color: #2563EB !important;
  transform: rotate(180deg) !important;
}

.faq-collapse {
  transition: grid-template-rows 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.faq-collapse-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.faq-content a:hover, .faq-content a:hover .elementor-heading-title, .faq-content a:hover .elementor-icon, .faq-content a:hover .elementor-button {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.faq-bullet-list {
  list-style: none;
}

.faq-bullet-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.faq-footer-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  background-color: #0F172A;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

.faq-footer-btn:hover {
  background-color: #334155 !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.faq-footer-btn svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.elementor-widget-heading[class*="badge"] .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-widget-heading[class*="pill"] .elementor-heading-title,
[class*="badge"] .elementor-heading-title,
[class*="pill"] .elementor-heading-title {
  line-height: 1 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.faq-trigger button,
.faq-trigger .composite-trigger {
  appearance: none !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  padding: 20px 24px !important;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 0px !important;
}

.faq-footer-btn button,
.faq-footer-btn .composite-trigger {
  appearance: none !important;
  background: #0f172a !important;
  border: none !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 10px 20px !important;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: normal !important;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .faq-trigger {
  padding: 18px 18px;
  min-height: 56px;
  }

  .faq-question {
  font-size: 16px;
  }

  .faq-indicator {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  }

  .faq-footer-btn {
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: center;
  }
}
</style>
